Title: Relates to the adoption of the Mass Timber International Building Code (IBC) Standard Type IV-A, IV-B, and IV-C
Summary: Directs the adoption of the Mass Timber International Building Code (IBC) Standard Type IV-A, IV-B, and IV-C by the state fire prevention and building code council; directs the NYC commissioner of buildings to submit the code for adoption by the city council.
LawCode: Amd §378, Exec L; amd §28-701.1, NYC Ad Cd
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the executive law and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the adoption of the Mass Timber International Building Code (IBC) Standard Type IV-A, IV-B, and IV-C
